title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 22: who may eat the holy things, and which animals may be offered to Yahweh.

questions.text: A descendant of Aaron who was a leper or had a discharge could not eat the holy things until when?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says such a man shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean.

answers.text: Until the seventh day of the month
Until he has offered a ram

questions.text: After touching something unclean and bathing, when did a priest become clean again?
questions.explanation: He was unclean until the evening and had to bathe; when the sun was down he was clean and could eat of the holy things.

questions.text: Who was NOT allowed to eat of the holy thing?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says no stranger shall eat of it, including a foreigner living with the priests or a hired servant. A slave bought by a priest and those born in his house could eat it.

answers.text: A slave bought with a priest's money
Someone born in a priest's house

questions.text: What does verse 12 say about a priest's daughter who is married to an outsider?
questions.explanation: If a priest's daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

answers.text: She shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things
She must return to her father's house
She must give a fifth part to the priest
She may eat it only on the Sabbath

questions.text: If a man ate something holy unwittingly, what did he have to add when he gave it back to the priest?
questions.explanation: He had to add the fifth part of its value to it and give the holy thing to the priest.

answers.text: The fifth part of its value
A tenth part of its value

questions.text: What kind of animal had to be offered for a burnt offering to be accepted?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says they had to offer a male without defect, of the bulls, the sheep or the goats.

answers.text: A female in its first year

questions.text: A bull or lamb with a deformity could be offered for which offering, but not for a vow?
questions.explanation: Such an animal could be offered for a free will offering, but for a vow it would not be accepted.

questions.text: From whose hand were the Israelites not to offer such defective animals as the bread of their God?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says they must not offer any of these from the hand of a foreigner, because there is a defect in them.

questions.text: How long did a newborn bull, sheep or goat have to stay with its mother?
questions.explanation: It had to remain seven days with its mother; from the eighth day on it could be accepted as an offering made by fire.

questions.text: What must not be done with a cow or a ewe, according to verse 28?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says you shall not kill a cow or ewe and its young both in one day.

answers.text: Offer it to Yahweh for a vow
Milk it on the Sabbath day
Kill it and its young both in one day
Sell it to a foreigner in the land
